from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
from rich.text import Text
t=Text('see https://user@example.org/path here')
ReprHighlighter().highlight(t)
print([ (s.start,s.end,str(s.style)) for s in t.spans])
"

turns.reply: The URL now highlights as a whole when it contains `@`. I'll submit the patch.

I added `@` to the URL character class in `ReprHighlighter` (`rich/highlighter.py`), so a URL like `https://user@example.org/path` is now highlighted as one `repr.url` span; I checked that with a one-off script but did not run the test suite, and submitted the one-file patch.
